title: Normalized scalar-extension map of ring-site Hom complexes
statement: Let $A,B$ be commutative rings, $\varphi:A\to B$ a ring homomorphism, and $\mathcal M_A,\mathcal M_B$ the categories of sheaves of modules on the one-object category with only its identity and bottom topology, with constant rings $A,B$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Let $F:\mathcal M_A\to\mathcal M_B$ be additive, with specified object equalities $h_M:F(M)=M\otimes_A B$ and maps equal to scalar extension transported by $h_M,h_N$ [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. For arbitrary cochain complexes $P,Q$, let $F^\bullet$ apply $F$ termwise and let $H_A,H_B$ be the shared Hom complexes with the actual chosen product projections [def-pur-hom-complex] into internal Homs [def-pur-sheaf-hom]. There exists a chain map $\chi_{P,Q}:F^\bullet H_A(P,Q)\to H_B(F^\bullet P,F^\bullet Q)$ such that, at every degree $n$, coordinate $p$, site object $U$ and sections $f\in H_A(P,Q)^n(U)$, $x\in P^p(U)$ and $b,c\in B$, its evaluation satisfies $\operatorname{ev}_p(\chi_{P,Q}(b\otimes f))(c\otimes x)=bc\otimes\operatorname{ev}_p(f)(x)$. Each displayed pure tensor means the tensor followed by the shared sheafification unit and the inverse of $h$, and each evaluation uses the projection chosen with $H_A$ or $H_B$, then the identity slice object. No boundedness, projectivity, perfectness, flatness or derived-category hypothesis is imposed.

lean.statement: theorem normalizedRingHomExtension_exists {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] (φ : A →+* B) (F : RingSiteModules A ⥤ RingSiteModules B) (h : ∀ M, F.obj M = SheafOfModules.changeOfRings (ringSiteMap φ) M) (hm : ∀ {M N} (f : M ⟶ N), F.map f = eqToHom (h M) ≫ SheafOfModules.changeOfRingsHom (ringSiteMap φ) M f ≫ eqToHom (h N).symm) (hF : F.Additive) (P Q : CochainComplex (RingSiteModules A) ℤ) : ∃ χ : (ringExtensionComplex F hF).obj (homComplex (R := CochainComplex.onePointRingSheaf A) P Q) ⟶ homComplex (R := CochainComplex.onePointRingSheaf B) ((ringExtensionComplex F hF).obj P) ((ringExtensionComplex F hF).obj Q), ∀ (n p : ℤ) (U : (Discrete PUnit.{u + 1})ᵒᵖ) (b c : B) (f : (homComplex (R := CochainComplex.onePointRingSheaf A) P Q).X n |>.val.obj U) (x : (P.X p).val.obj U), ringHomEvaluate ((ringExtensionComplex F hF).obj P) ((ringExtensionComplex F hF).obj Q) n p U (((χ.f n).val.app U) (ringExtensionPure φ F h _ U b f)) (ringExtensionPure φ F h (P.X p) U c x) = ringExtensionPure φ F h (Q.X (p + n)) U (b * c) (ringHomEvaluate P Q n p U f x)
